network-traffic-field-mapping.title: Network Traffic field mapping (Common Information Model)

flow_log_entry_id.format: An opaque per-project id, for example 15cga7ffoafeds.

flow_log_time.quote: The time the event described by the log entry occurred.

flow_receive_time.format: RFC 3339 timestamp with nanosecond precision; usually within a second or two of flow_log_time in the sample data.
flow_receive_time.quote: The time the log entry was received by Logging.

flow_start_time.quote: Timestamp of the first observed packet during the aggregation time interval

flow_end_time.quote: Timestamp of the last observed packet during the aggregation time interval

flow_reporter.quote: The side that reported the flow

SRC_GATEWAY.meaning: Reported by a Cloud Interconnect or Cloud VPN gateway on the source side.

DEST_GATEWAY.meaning: Reported by a Cloud Interconnect or Cloud VPN gateway on the destination side.

flow_src_ip.format: A dotted IPv4 or an IPv6 address.
flow_src_ip.quote: Source IP address. Populated for all flows.

flow_dest_ip.format: A dotted IPv4 or an IPv6 address.
flow_dest_ip.quote: Destination IP address. Populated for all flows.

flow_reporting_device.format: The same shape as flow_src_ip or flow_dest_ip, whichever applies.

flow_src_port.quote: Populated for TCP and UDP flows

flow_dest_port.quote: Populated for TCP and UDP flows

flow_protocol.format: The IANA protocol number, an integer.

6.meaning: TCP (Transmission Control), per the IANA protocol numbers registry.

flow_bytes_sent.quote: Estimated number of user payload bytes sent from the source to the destination.

flow_packets_sent.quote: Estimated number of packets sent from the source to the destination.

examples.note: no round trip measured in the aggregation interval

flow_duration.format: An integer count, the add-on's own unit.

gcp_project_id.format: A Google Cloud project id string.
gcp_project_id.quote: ID of the Google Cloud project that contains the VM resource

gcp_subnetwork_name.quote: Name of the subnet, if applicable

gke_cluster_location.format: A Google Cloud region or zone name.

gke_pod_name.format: A Kubernetes pod name, usually deployment-hash-suffix.

flow_resource_kind.format: One fixed word naming the Monitored Resource type.
flow_resource_kind.quote: A Subnetwork in Google Compute Engine.

gce_subnetwork.meaning: The log entry is attributed to a Compute Engine subnetwork; every sampled flow log entry carries this value.

gcs_time_micros.format: An integer, microseconds since the Unix epoch.
gcs_time_micros.quote: The time that the request was completed, in microseconds since the Unix epoch

gcs_client_ip.format: A dotted IPv4 or an IPv6 address.
gcs_client_ip.quote: The IP address from which the request was made

gcs_client_ip_region.format: Empty in every sampled event; the column is reserved and not yet populated.

gcs_request_uri.format: A path, optionally followed by a ? and a query string.

gcs_status.format: A three-digit HTTP status code, plus the add-on's own reason-phrase decode.
gcs_status.quote: The HTTP status code the server sent in response

404.meaning: The named object or path was not found (action: Not Found).

gcs_request_bytes.quote: The number of bytes sent in the request

gcs_response_bytes.quote: The number of bytes sent in the response

gcs_response_time.format: An integer count, microseconds; the add-on also carries a millisecond conversion.
gcs_response_time.quote: The time it took to serve the request in microseconds

gcs_server_host.quote: The host in the original request

examples.note: a request made directly against the object's own address

gcs_referer.format: A full URL, or empty when the client sent none.
gcs_referer.quote: The HTTP referrer for the request

examples.note: empty when the client sent no Referer header, as in the sample PATCH request
extracted from referer host 99.88.77.66; see the referer_domain_bug hazard

gcs_operation.format: A fixed operation-name word, or empty.

examples.note: an object-level GET; empty for a bucket- or project-level call the usage log does not classify as an object operation, as in the sample PATCH on the bucket itself

gcs_bucket.quote: The bucket specified in the request

gcs_object.quote: The object specified in this request

examples.note: empty for a request not scoped to one object, as in the sample bucket-level PATCH
